---
applyTo: "apps/web/src/**/*.ts,apps/web/src/**/*.tsx"
---
## i18n Rules (next-intl)

- Use `next-intl` translation keys for all user-facing text.
- Do not hardcode visible UI strings.
- Apply i18n coverage to user-visible validation and error text as well.
- Keep translation namespaces consistent with feature/domain boundaries.
- Prefer existing translation key groups before creating new key families.
